title: Fork Serena typed read surface and private semantic worker

tests.name: test/contracts/semantic-adapter.test.js
tests.detail: framing, budget enforcement, dead interpreter as a typed retryable failure

tests.name: test/contracts/unified-engine.test.js
tests.detail: real pyright: symbol and references return anchored lsp evidence; with no configured server the refusal reason reaches the operator

tests.name: scripts/compatibility.mjs LAZY_INTEL_ENGINE=unified
tests.detail: real typescript-language-server: references and symbol over a JavaScript workspace

findings: No minimal read entry existed upstream: the symbol tools require a Tool/agent/project context. lazy_read_api.py constructs LanguageServerManager and LanguageServerSymbolRetriever explicitly and returns plain data.

Language servers are never discovered and never installed. The operator names executables in LAZY_INTEL_LSP as language to absolute path; an unnamed language is refused with that exact reason rather than downloading anything.
Measured Python import closure needs 14 third-party packages, not serena's full 33 pins.

Defect found and fixed by the end-to-end run: a reference item carried the referencing symbol's own file, so a cross-file reference pointed at the wrong file. lazy_read_api now emits reference_relative_path and the adapter prefers it. The engine's source verifier had flagged this as `mismatch`, which is what exposed it.
includeBody is forwarded, and the body is preferred as the evidence text because it is what the locator actually spans and therefore what a source check can verify.
knownLimitations: implementations and diagnostics return unsupported_capability. They are separate Serena tools that this read API does not expose, and answering them from a file overview would be a confident wrong answer.
Only python and typescript language servers were exercised on this host.
rollback: Unset LAZY_INTEL_ENGINE; the external Serena MCP adapter is untouched.
